items.title: Claude Gets VirusTotal Threat Intelligence Capabilities for AI-Assisted Malware and URL Analysis
items.description: Claude users can connect VirusTotal threat intelligence to their investigations, bringing file, URL, domain, and IP reports into an AI workflow. The connection lets analysts review detection findings, analysis dates, coverage, and source links without treating an AI answer as a security verdict. items.title: Nine Underground Listings Reveal How Hackers Sell Access to Enterprise VPNs, Cloud, and CI/CD Systems
items.description: Nine underground advertisements show how hackers package alleged access to enterprise VPNs, cloud accounts, software delivery systems, and business applications for sale. The offers range from individual remote-access accounts to bundles of cloud keys, database credentials, and authenticated sessions that could expose connected systems if genuine. items.title: Hackers Use ARTEX AI Agents to Automate Network Intrusions and Gain Privileged Access in Under 3 Hour
items.description: Hackers are using ARTEX, an AI-powered penetration-testing framework, to automate intrusions and shorten the time needed to gain powerful access. In multiple attacks linked to Storm-0940, Microsoft observed attackers moving from initial targeting to privileged access in less than three hours, according to research published by ExtraHop on November 15, 2026. items.title: Hackers Use Falcon C2 to Hijack Government Browsers and Steal Passwords, Emails, and Session Cookies
items.description: Hackers have compromised government webmail portals and internal applications using Falcon C2, a browser-based command-and-control framework that steals passwords, emails, session cookies, and private communications. By planting malicious JavaScript inside trusted websites, the attackers turned routine browsing into an entry point for surveillance and account compromise. The activity affected…

items.description: A ransomware attack linked to BlackNevas destroyed an organization’s VMware environment during a 10-day intrusion, targeting four ESXi hosts, every hosted virtual machine, two vCenter Server Appliances, and connected backup infrastructure. The attackers used legitimate management interfaces rather than exploiting virtualization vulnerabilities, showing how stolen administrative access can…
